body: From your note "make it cozier, cutier". Real sheep size and shape (it was too small next to the cow and horse): body about 1.1 m, back about 0.75 m. A round cloud of wool, a soft face with big shiny eyes, rosy cheeks, a wool fringe, ears out to the sides with pink insides, the nose joined to a little mouth by one line, wool trousers on the legs and dark hooves. Black sheep: charcoal wool, lighter face. Lamb: bigger head, shorter legs, rounder body (Age: Baby). Pick in Model Compare (Farm animals → Sheep).

comments.text: Redone from your note. Viewer: 3 passes, last 8.5/10, nothing above minor left.
Done: more wool (your note). Pick in Model Compare.
